name: Codex Dots can now drive several of your own machines, not only its cloud computer
title: Codex Dots can now drive several of your own machines, not only its cloud computer
summary: OpenAI's Dots agent can now be connected to multiple local computers, and you choose which one runs a given task, for example building and testing on a desktop while you code on a laptop. It is announced with an 18 second clip and no docs link in the post.
